Adept at bridging business strategy with scalable, secure technology solutions—driving innovation, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes through structured program execution and modern cloud-based architectures.

CORE COMPETENCIES
Program, Project & Portfolio Governance and Delivery Management: • Oversee end-to-end program and project delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and scope • Lead cross-functional IT programs aligned with organizational strategic goals • Multi model engagement Managed services, Staff augmentation & Global competitive centers (GCC), ODC, Near
shore Models
Develop business cases, go-to-market strategies, and manage P&L and costs - Budget & P&L Ownership ($5M annual programs)
Regular reporting to the Executive Steering Committee for $5M annual programs, covering budget oversight, risk mitigation, and transformation milestones.
Driving the cost efficiency of the competency clusters (Delivery Units), and maximizing the Business Units throughput & productivity and focus on the inclusive culture of the organization • Expert in Fixed Price, Cost Reimbursable, and Time and Material contract models • Experience in managing programs with the team size and span of 30 to 50 associates
Product Strategy, Roadmap & Market Opportunities: • Define product roadmaps by operationalizing defined strategy. • Articulate product ideas to capture attention and compel action despite obstacles and competing priorities. • Identify opportunities in the market landscape. • Support product launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross-functional teams and
stakeholders.
Prioritize product features and enhancements based on customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility. • Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including positioning, messaging, pricing, and promotional plans.
Generative AI Knowledge, AI/ML Model Development & Deployment: • Utilize knowledge of Generative AI frameworks, models, and tools to drive program success and innovation. • Utilize AI Companion - Microsoft Copilot to enhance productivity by providing contextual assistance, automation,
and insights
Design, develop, and deploy AI and ML models to solve complex business problems. • Drive innovation by applying AI/ML techniques to develop new products and enhance existing solutions. • Work closely with data engineers, software developers, and business analysts to integrate AI/ML models into production systems.
Utilize strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, and Java to develop and deploy models. • Apply AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, and Keras. • Leverage cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) for model training, deployment, and scaling.
Client Engagement, Delivery & Innovation Leadership: • Lead end-to-end client engagement from RFP/RFI response through program delivery and steady-state operations
across enterprise and public-sector environments.
Manage Fixed Price, T&M, and Managed Services engagements with structured SLA governance and continuous service improvement.
Act as trusted advisor to stakeholders, aligning business objectives with technical execution and driving Agile/SAFe adoption where appropriate.
Drive innovation initiatives across IoT, AI/ML, Data Analytics, and Cloud transformation programs. • Manage escalations, executive communication, and stakeholder reporting to ensure high customer satisfaction and delivery excellence.
Solution Design, Architecture and Delivery Excellence: • Experience in Application Development, System Integration, ERP deployments, and Cloud platforms • Prepare Solution designs, High-Level Designs (HLD), and Low-Level Designs (LLD) Implement DevOps practices throughout the software engineering lifecycle • • Expertise in CI/CD process development using Git, Jenkins, Maven, Gradle
Technical Leadership & Proficiency: • Strong technical background with cross-functional team experience. • Certified Implementation Specialist, specializing in large-scale IT services deployment and integration. • Proficient in project management tools (Microsoft Project, JIRA) and processes. • Expertise in tools like Primavera, Confluence, Oracle ESA, PeopleSoft, and ERP/CRM applications. • Extensive experience in Office Automation tools (MS-Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Email).
Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Service Delivery and Managed Services (24x7) Support: • End-to-end experience in SDLC, including Requirement Understanding, Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing,
Configuration Management, Release Management, Deployment, and Support.
Aligning IT services with business needs, maintaining high service quality, and continuously improving service performance to drive business value and support organizational goals.
Risk, Issue Management and Change Management: • • Develop and implement mitigation strategies and contingency plans to address potential challenges. • Anticipate, manage change requirements, develop and implement change management plans to ensure smooth
Identify, assess, and manage risks and issues throughout the program lifecycle.
transitions and stakeholder adoption.
Operational Excellence (OpEx) Process Improvement, Quality Management & Metrics Implementation: • Prepare Quality Management Plan (QMP) to describe how quality will be managed throughout the lifecycle of the project and guide project team to execute quality management, quality assurance and quality control activities for the project or program
Define and track key product, project metrics to measure success and drive continuous improvement. • Application of industry best practices and engineering metrics for enhanced project quality.

Product / Program & AI/ML Technology Stack
Proficient in Project Management processes and tools like MS Project, Primavera, JIRA, Confluence, Office Automation: MS-Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Email • DevOps: GitHub, Jenkins, Sonar Qube, Maven, CI/CD pipeline building • AI/ML - Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch - AI/ML lifecycle governance, model
validation, deployment oversight, and production integration.
